description:
Job Title: Mendix Developer 
 
Job Category: Information Technology 
 
Time Type: Full time 
 
Minimum Clearance Required to Start: Secret 
 
Employee Type: Regular 
 
Percentage of Travel Required: Up to 10% 
 
Type of Travel: Local 
 
* * * 
 
 
 
 The Opportunity: 
We are seeking a skilled Mendix Developer to support the Joint Transportation Management System (JTMS) program. The ideal candidate will leverage the Mendix low-code platform to design, develop, and deploy enterprise applications that support transportation and logistics operations. This position offers an opportunity to work on mission-critical defense applications while utilizing cutting-edge low-code development technologies. 

 The JTMS Mendix Developer will be responsible for building and maintaining applications using the Mendix low-code platform to support transportation management and logistics workflows. This role involves collaborating with business stakeholders, system architects, and other developers to deliver scalable, secure, and user-friendly applications that meet operational requirements and enhance mission effectiveness.


 Responsibilities: 

 Design, develop, test, and deploy applications using the Mendix low-code platform 
 Create and maintain domain models, microflows, nanoflows, and page layouts in Mendix Studio Pro 
 Develop RESTful and SOAP web services for system integration 
 Build responsive user interfaces that meet accessibility and usability standards 
 Integrate Mendix applications with external systems, databases, and APIs 
 Implement custom widgets and modules using JavaScript, Java, or React when needed 
 Perform code reviews and ensure adherence to Mendix best practices and coding standards 
 Collaborate with business analysts and stakeholders to gather and refine requirements 
 Create and maintain technical documentation for applications and integrations 
 Troubleshoot and resolve application defects and performance issues 
 Participating in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, and retrospectives 
 Optimize application performance and ensure scalability 
 Implement security best practices and ensure compliance with government standards 
 Support application deployments across development, test, and production environments 
 Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior team members 
 Stay current with Mendix platform updates and new features
 
 Qualifications: 

 Technical Skills : 

 Mendix Studio Pro 
 Domain Modeling 
 Microflows and Nanoflows 
 REST/SOAP APIs 
 SQL and Database Management 
 JavaScript/Java (for custom development) 
 Version Control (Git/SVN) 
 Agile SAFe Methodologies
 
 Required:  

 Active Secret Clearance
 Must be a US Citizen
 Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or related field 
 3+ years of software development experience with at least 2 years of Mendix development 
 Strong proficiency with Mendix Studio Pro and Mendix platform architecture 
 Experience with domain modeling, microflows, and page design in Mendix 
 Knowledge of REST and SOAP web services integration 
 Understanding of relational databases and data modeling concepts 
 Proficiency in SQL for data queries and manipulation 
 Familiarity with Agile/Scrum development methodologies 
 Strong problem-solving and analytical skills 
 Excellent communication and collaboration abilities 
 Experience with version control systems (SVN, Git) 
 Team player skills to collaborate with other teams 
 Build out wireframes from requirements
 
 Desired: 

 Mendix Rapid Developer or Advanced Developer certification 
 Experience with JavaScript, Java, HTML5, CSS3, and React 
 Knowledge of Mendix mobile app development 
 Experience with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices 
 Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or Mendix Cloud) 
 Understanding of microservices architecture 
 Experience with transportation or logistics systems 
 Knowledge of DoD security requirements and compliance standards 
 Experience integrating with government systems and databases 
 Background in enterprise application development 
 Familiarity with JIRA, Confluence, or similar project management tools 
 Experience with SAP S/4 HANA


 
 
 
 
- 
 

 What You Can Expect: 
  A culture of integrity. 
 At CACI, we place character and innovation at the center of everything we do. As a valued team member, you’ll be part of a high-performing group dedicated to our customer’s missions and driven by a higher purpose – to ensure the safety of our nation.
 An environment of trust. 
 CACI values the unique contributions that every employee brings to our company and our customers - every day. You’ll have the autonomy to take the time you need through a unique flexible time off benefit and have access to robust learning resources to make your ambitions a reality.
 A focus on continuous growth. 
 Together, we will advance our nation's most critical missions, build on our lengthy track record of business success, and find opportunities to break new ground — in your career and in our legacy.
 
 

 Pay Range : 
 There are a host of factors that can influence final salary including, but not limited to, geographic location, Federal Government contract labor categories and contract wage rates, relevant prior work experience, specific skills and competencies, education, and certifications. Our employees value the flexibility at CACI that allows them to balance quality work and their personal lives. We offer competitive compensation, benefits and learning and development opportunities. Our broad and competitive mix of benefits options is designed to support and protect employees and their families. At CACI, you will receive comprehensive benefits such as; healthcare, wellness, financial, retirement, family support, continuing education, and time off benefits.
 
 Since this position can be worked in more than one location, the range shown is the national average for the position.
 
 The proposed salary range for this position is: 
$75,200-$158,100 
 
 CACI is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected characteristic.
